A leaker who previously discovered the iPhone Duo feature in Apple's code has now found something similar in the HomePad code. The setup process for this upcoming device shares common features with Apple's foldable iPhone.

The leaker said the setup process will take place within the Home app, and shared three screenshots of the setup process……

iPhone Duo StandBy mode

Apple's StandBy mode offers many features, allowing you to turn your iPhone into a useful information display while charging the device. Leaker pdfu previously shared five unreleased StandBy screens for the iPhone Duo found in the Xcode simulator.

  • Home Camera
  • Home Modular
  • Flow
  • Fade
  • Snoopy

HomePad setup screen

One of the screen options in StandBy mode is Photo Face, and pdfu indicated that HomePad will also have this option.

He explained that the setup process will have HomePad first extract a few high-resolution photos for you to choose immediately, so you have something to look at while your entire photo library is downloading from iCloud.

Apple's smart home hub is expected to launch on October 13, with a design reportedly inspired by the iMac G4. To learn more about the design, you can read about it here.
